log: minion-qf-mergefile: merge.mjs overlap path is now a three-way merge per file (git merge-file --diff3), all files computed in memory first, nothing written on any conflict; git apply dropped. Finding: git merge-file ALSO calls edits on adjacent lines a conflict (git's own rule), so case (e) failed with plain merge-file; added a line-by-line settle step inside each conflict block (LCS diff of each side against the base; both applied only when they touch different base lines; same line or same insertion point stays a conflict). Deviation from brief: base = merge-base of michael/dev and the branch, not michael/dev itself, so a dev that moved on is not reverted; identical when the branch is current. Also --no-renames on the changed-file list so a rename's old path is removed.
